question: Should OpenClaw add this durable AI-safety taxonomy and the `safetyEventTypes`/`safetyDiagnostics.emit` plugin contract to core now, or should the work be narrowed to existing diagnostics seams and an external plugin until a core API owner sponsors it?
rationale: This is a broad new product, persistence, Gateway, UI, and plugin-SDK surface; code review cannot determine whether the permanent public contract and operator data-retention model are desired.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow core contract
options.body: Approve a documented minimal event schema and plugin capability boundary, then fix authoritative session attribution and provide full final-head behavior proof.

options.title: Keep core generic
options.body: Move taxonomy-specific exporters, dashboards, and plugin emission behavior to an external plugin while retaining only a demonstrably necessary generic core seam.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave the canonical request open until an owner defines the product, privacy, retention, and SDK compatibility requirements.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow core contract
recommendation.body: Approve a documented minimal event schema and plugin capability boundary, then fix authoritative session attribution and provide full final-head behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They can clarify the intended feature scope and revise the proposal, while an OpenClaw maintainer must supply the required sponsorship.
